statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness
The patient has known unspecified atrial fibrillation (I48.91)
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) was ordered
The service was to evaluate for arrhythmic burden and optimize anticoagulation management
The claim was denied under reason code CO-22
This service is medically necessary to detect clinically significant atrial fibrillation episodes that guide stroke risk assessment and anticoagulation decisions
